description: This PHP source file handles AJAX requests related to wireless network configuration, including functions for Wi-Fi settings, WPS configuration, MAC filtering, and network parameter updates. It includes input validation, session checks, and calls to external utility functions.

methods.name: validChecksum
methods.description: Validates a WPS PIN checksum with correct length and Luhn algorithm.

methods.name: validFilterParam
methods.description: Validates filter parameters ensuring printable characters and valid MAC addresses.

methods.name: MiniApplySSID
methods.description: Applies settings to a specific SSID by updating its radio settings.
